dc:description: One saved mean or paired mean difference for one ownership population and degree; three measure records are produced from each source row.
dc:title: Within pi participation
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: measure: derived literal funded_mean, unfunded_mean, or paired_difference; value: funded_mean: mean_funded_works_per_year; unfunded_mean: mean_unfunded_works_per_year; paired_difference: mean_paired_difference_works_per_year; support_PIs: PIs; support_institutions: institutions; preceding_window: preceding_funding_window_FY; completion_year_excluded: completion_FY_excluded; source_inference: inference; interval_status: literal not_computed; interval_unavailable_reason: literal finite_panel_description_no_inference
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
